message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former U.S. Vice President Al Gore presents a compelling case for the science of climate change and its global impact. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up to the original film, this documentary examines the progress (or lack thereof) in addressing climate change over the decade since the first release. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the effects of climate change and discusses solutions to mitigate its impact. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A concise, data‑driven overview of the science behind climate change, its consequences, and potential policy responses. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global environmental documentary featuring interviews with scientists, activists, and leaders discussing the urgent need to address climate change. |

If you’d like more details on any of these films or additional recommendations, just let me know!
